page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with a centred heading "DEDICATIO" at the top. No margin notes. Faint digitiser watermark at lower right, not transcribed.

main_text.head: D E D I C A T I O.
main_text.p: incolumes, dum interim alia omnia denso agmine, perrumpentia in adversis rebus consolationum ejusmodi fructum penitus intervertunt; ne quicquam sperant. Optime vero & potentissime ille miserationum Pater; ille Imperator noster Sapientissimus, suis prospexit, Divina quadam παναρτλία eos instruens, & salutarium consolationum suavissima ϑελκτήρια animis eorum infundens, ut in impetuoso hoc pelago destituti naufragæ ventis, remos adhibeant gratiæ, positaque sarcina peccati adversus infestas malorum omnium, quibus impugnantur, acies certa spe victoriæ, ut fortes milites & Calliniei Christi, depugnent. Quarum consolationum efficacissimarum duplex in Scripturis irriguus fons est. Aliæ enim in universum dulcissimis promissionibus, quarum lætissima in iis seges, & intermicantes ubique gemmæ continentur, languentes animos demulcent: aliæ certa contemplatione personarum, temporum, vicissitudinum, periodorum Ecclesiæ modo fluctuantis & luctantis, modo elucantis: lunæ hujus

page.notes: Several Greek words are printed in a spaced, sometimes obscured type and are approximate: "παναρτλία" (probably παρακλησις-type word, reading uncertain), "ϑελκτήρια" (uncertain). Ink damage and faint spots on the page; "Calliniei" and "naufragæ" are as far as the scan allows and may be doubtful. Last line is the page's final printed line.
